name: Mello Fellos Saturday Ride

cost: free for one guest ride; membership from $25 a year
name: COGS Wednesday Evening Ride

pace: Evening exercise ride; pace set per ride
visitor_notes: Register on the club site first. Non-members may join one COGS ride under the club's insurance policy, then need to join. Rain doesn't usually cancel it.

schedule: Thursdays at 11:00 am from Issaquah (Oct 1: Tibbetts Valley Skateboard Park). Steady pace.

host.name: Cascade Bicycle Club Free Group Rides

visitor_notes: Free, but sign in on Cascade's site and register for each ride. Helmet and a safety briefing at the start are required.

name: Eastside Tours Evening Ride
schedule: Thursdays at 6:20 pm (briefing, then roll out); winter location is the east parking lot of Crossroads Park. First ride of each month is burrito night.

start_location.name: Crossroads Park, east parking lot (enter off 164th)

pace: Brisk, 16-18 mph on the flat; mellow on flats, hills at your own pace; about 1,500 ft of climbing

host.name: Cascade Bicycle Club Free Group Rides

name: Monday Moderate Ride
schedule: Every Monday, meet at 9:15 am at the Proctor Starbucks to sign in; leisurely group leaves 9:15, faster group (14-16 mph) at 9:30.

visitor_notes: No membership needed to try a ride, but sign the TWBC waiver. A ride leader may be present, or may not, so bring the route. Strava rates it Beginner / Rolling.
description: TWBC's Monday-morning ride from Proctor. It runs down to the waterfront, loops Point Defiance, and heads on to University Place and Fircrest for coffee. About 23 miles at a leisurely pace, with a faster group leaving 15 minutes later.
evidence: TWBC's Strava event page lists Monday Moderate Ride for Mon Oct 5, 2026 at 9:15 am, Proctor, rated Beginner / Rolling, and the club's public Google calendar carries the weekly entry (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Strava event page shows the next date without a login; the club's public Google calendar repeats it weekly.

name: Saturday Donut Ride

name: Wednesday Winter Trail Ride (with lights)

start_location.name: Depot Market parking lot, across from Boundary Bay Brewery

visitor_notes: Bring front and rear lights. A cyclocross or trail-ready bike works. Road tires aren't great. Register on the club's event page; non-members can sign up at no fee.
description: The Mount Baker Bicycle Club's fall and winter Wednesday night ride on the trails, about 90 minutes with lights. It leaves from the Depot Market lot downtown. Cyclocross and old steel mountain bikes are fine.
evidence: Mount Baker Bicycle Club's calendar lists the Wednesday Workout Trail Ride (winter schedule, with lights) for Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026 at 6:00 pm (fetched Oct 1, 2026).
